commentary: Strong product shot with a faceted crystal bottle on marble displaying vivid amber liquid. The lighting is warm and dramatic but leans toward frontal/top illumination rather than dedicated rim lighting. Reflections on the marble surface are modest but the overall presentation is polished and commercial.

Excellent product photography execution with a crystal-clear rectangular bottle under focused spot lighting on white marble. Rim lighting is evident in the halo effect on the marble below the bottle. All major prompt criteria are met with professional-quality execution.

Exceptional product photography with dramatic rim lighting that beautifully catches the bottle edges and illuminates the amber liquid. The dark background creates high contrast while the white marble adds luxury context. Surface reflections are clean and the overall image reads as top-tier commercial product photography.

Strong product image with excellent rim lighting creating prominent edge highlights on the crystal bottle. The marble surface shows detailed veining with dramatic light casting and reflections. The composition is clean and the amber liquid appears rich and saturated.

Beautiful natural-light editorial image with a cylindrical bottle casting a dramatic warm shadow across white marble. The amber liquid and clear glass are well-executed, but the lighting style is editorial/natural rather than the controlled studio product photography feel specified. The marble and rim lighting are excellent.

Competent product shot on marble with clear amber liquid in a well-shaped bottle, but the lighting is diffuse rather than the dramatic rim lighting specified. The text label is prominently displayed but the overall image lacks the high-contrast drama of true rim lighting. Reflections are minimal.

Outstanding product photography with a beautifully faceted crystal bottle displaying dramatic rim lighting that creates brilliant edge highlights and internal light refraction. The marble surface reflections are crisp and the amber liquid glows through the crystal glass. This is the most technically accomplished image in the set.

Clean professional product shot with good rim lighting creating edge definition on the rectangular bottle. The amber liquid is well-rendered and the composition is minimalist with a dark gradient background. Surface reflections exist but are understated compared to the best in the set.
